notes: Only assigned unfinished original fields examined. Other fields are unassigned null placeholders. PDF pp. 16–17 inspected for layout, metric symbols and signs; evidence quotes retain canonical text. Printed index of moderated mediation. Standardization is not established, so not labeled unstandardized b. The bootstrap mediation section reports a 95% confidence interval and narrative verdict for this effect, with no same-effect p value. P values earlier in the section are for component/direct paths and cannot be substituted.
